catalyst.what_ends_it: Amendment No. 2's October 27 release, filed October 28, extends expiration to one minute after 11:59 p.m. New York City time on November 12, 2026, unless the offer is extended again or ended sooner.

forced_seller_or_ignored_buyer.text: The company is the buyer. Common stock, strategic warrants, and each pre-funded class still need a 50 percent minimum tender inside that class, and the classes are independent. Calling holders who do not fit that tender an ignored buyer is an inference.

notes: Bastion's approximate 9.9 percent stake was not in these filings. The 9.99 percent figure is a warrant exercise blocker summarized from a 13G/A.

one_number.text: $3.00 cash for up to 95% of common (48,311,489 shares)

pass_if.text: Pass for a small holder if the common-stock class misses its 50 percent minimum, or if proration on the 95 percent cap leaves little stock accepted. Not a price target.

statements.text: SkyAI's October 16, 2026 Schedule TO-I offers $3.00 cash per share, less $0.0001 for pre-funded and strategic warrants, for up to 48,311,489 shares, which the offer says is about 95 percent of shares outstanding on October 15, 2026.

The original offer expired one minute after 11:59 p.m. New York City time on October 29, 2026 unless extended, stated an aggregate price of up to $201,260,220, an asset value of about $223.8 million in cash, and 30 percent withholding on gross proceeds to a non-U.S. holder unless a lower rate is established.

Amendment No. 2's October 27 release extends expiration to one minute after 11:59 p.m. New York City time on November 12, 2026, lifts each pre-funded class from 95 percent to 100 percent at $3.00 less $0.0001, and adds stapled warrants with a $9.75 exercise price at a $0.17 purchase price for up to 100 percent of each class. Common stock and strategic warrants stay at up to 95 percent and $3.00, and the 50 percent in-class minimum remains.
The same Amendment No. 2 release says that if every security sought is tendered the company will pay about $214.3 million, and that the company holds about $223 million in cash.

The offer's summary of the August 14, 2026 13G/A lists Bastion reporting persons at 1,345,417 common shares, pre-funded warrants for up to 4,234,615 shares, stapled warrants for up to 5,384,615 shares at Bastion Trading, and 2,940,075 common shares at Lucio Holding, with a 9.99 percent exercise blocker and a current cap of 4,294,891 shares for Mr. Zhu. The 9.99 percent figure is that blocker, not an ownership stake of 9.9 percent.

Amendment No. 3 files the October 27, 2026 Bastion support agreement by reference to the October 28 8-K. Bastion tenders the securities it beneficially owns that the offer accepts and accepts a three-year standstill. Subject to law, the company deletes the 30 percent non-U.S. withholding and agrees not to withhold it.

supporting_filings.note: Amendment No. 2 exhibit. Extension, 100 percent pre-funded, $0.17 stapled warrants.
Amendment No. 3. Bastion agreement and 30 percent withholding.

catalyst.what_ends_it: Abbott says it expects to complete a tax-free distribution of the Nutrition business by the end of 2027. No record date or distribution date is in the 8-K.

forced_seller_or_ignored_buyer.text: The 8-K does not name a holder who must sell, a ratio, or a when-issued window.

notes: Tax-free is the company's stated intention in the release, not a tax opinion.

pass_if.text: Pass until a Form 10 states a ratio, a record date, or who must sell. The end-of-2027 line is the company's expectation, not a trading window.

statements.text: Abbott's October 21, 2026 8-K says it intends to separate its global Nutrition business into an independent public company by a tax-free distribution to Abbott shareholders, and expects to finish by the end of 2027.
The same release says the Nutrition company would have about $8.5 billion in annual sales. It does not state a ratio, a record date, a new ticker, or a forced seller.

catalyst.what_ends_it: The earnings release in the October 29, 2026 8-K targets completion of the Trinzic spin-off on January 4, 2027, subject to board approval and customary conditions, including effectiveness of the Form 10 filed September 30, 2026.

forced_seller_or_ignored_buyer.text: The 8-K does not name a holder who must sell or a distribution ratio.

notes: No ratio was taken from the Form 10. The January 4 date is in Exhibit 99.1 of this 8-K.

pass_if.text: Pass until the Form 10 states a ratio, a record date, and who must sell. January 4 is a target with conditions, not a completed distribution.

statements.text: KBR's October 29, 2026 8-K earnings release says the Mission Technology Solutions spin-off, which will be named Trinzic, is targeted for January 4, 2027, subject to board approval and customary conditions, including effectiveness of the Form 10 filed September 30, 2026.
Item 7.01 of the same 8-K says KBR expects to spin off Trinzic, Inc. as an independent public company in January 2027.

catalyst.what_ends_it: The September 30, 2026 10-Q says FedEx expects to fully monetize its remaining FedEx Freight stake within 12 months of that balance sheet date, subject to market conditions.

forced_seller_or_ignored_buyer.text: Treating FedEx as a forced seller is an inference. The 10-Q says the company expects to monetize the 19.9 percent stake. It does not say FedEx must sell.

notes: Twelve months from the balance sheet date is September 30, 2027. That date is the window in the sentence, not a filed sale contract.

pass_if.text: Pass as a must-sell trade. The filing gives an expectation and a market-conditions qualifier, not a contractual sale deadline.

statements.text: FedEx's 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 says FedEx retained a 19.9 percent ownership interest in FedEx Freight common stock, carried at $3.3 billion on September 30, 2026 after a $1.2 billion unrealized loss.

The same 10-Q says FedEx expects to fully monetize the remaining FedEx Freight stake within 12 months of the September 30, 2026 balance sheet date, subject to market conditions. It does not say FedEx must sell.

catalyst.what_ends_it: The Rule 425 states a definitive agreement and the $65.00 price. It does not state a closing date or what ends the deal.

forced_seller_or_ignored_buyer.text: No forced seller is named. Up to 25 percent of the price can be DoorDash stock, subject to election and proration. Whether that stock is a merger security a usual holder will not want is an inference.

notes: Not classified as a no-vote deal. The 425 does not discuss a vote.

pass_if.text: Pass as a no-vote deal. This filing does not say whether holders vote, and it states no closing date and no CVR.

statements.text: DoorDash's October 29, 2026 Rule 425 says it has a definitive agreement to acquire Maplebear Inc. (Instacart) for $65.00 per share, at least 75 percent cash and up to 25 percent DoorDash common stock, subject to election and proration.

catalyst.what_ends_it: The October 16, 2026 8-K says the company expects November 6, 2026 to be the last NYSE trading day. Form 25 filed October 27, 2026 is the delisting notice and does not restate that date. Deregistration is expected November 9, 2026, then dissolution into a liquidating trust.

company: Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance, Inc.

forced_seller_or_ignored_buyer.text: After the transfer, beneficial interests will not be transferable, except for limited cases such as death or operation of law, and will not trade on an exchange. That is the filing. An index fund having to sell before the last NYSE day is an inference. The 8-K does not name an index.

notes: November 6 is an expectation in the 8-K, confirmed as the company's words, not as a completed last print.

pass_if.text: The last trading day is the company's expectation in the October 16 release. Pass if a later filing moves that day. Not a price target.

statements.text: Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance's October 16, 2026 8-K says it expects the last NYSE trading day to be November 6, 2026, expects to file a Form 25 on or about October 27, 2026, and expects to deregister on November 9, 2026, then transfer assets to a Maryland liquidating trust and dissolve.

The same release says beneficial interests in the liquidating trust will be distributed one-for-one and, with limited exceptions, will not be transferable and will not trade on the NYSE or any other exchange.
Form 25 filed October 27, 2026 notifies removal of the ARI common stock from NYSE listing under 17 CFR 240.12d2-2(c). It does not restate November 6.

supporting_filings.note: Voluntary NYSE delisting notice. Does not state November 6.

catalyst.what_ends_it: The exchange offer and withdrawal rights expired at 12:00 midnight, New York City time, at the end of October 9, 2026. Final results were released October 14, 2026.

forced_seller_or_ignored_buyer.text: Odd-lot holders, fewer than 100 Medtronic shares who tendered all of them, were accepted in full. Other tenders were prorated. Medtronic said it will not keep any MiniMed shares after the exchange.

notes: A 7 percent discount is in the separations register from prospectus 0001628280-26-064932. That prospectus was not re-read in this pass, so the 7 percent is not a fact on this row. Settlement date was not in the October 14 results release.

one_number.text: proration 18.289133%; odd lots accepted in full

outcome.text: Offer expired October 9, 2026. Final proration 18.289133 percent. Odd lots under 100 shares accepted in full. Medtronic keeps no MiniMed shares.

pass_if.text: The offer is over. A new pass would be a later filing that changes the accepted count or the proration factor.

statements.text: Medtronic's September 14, 2026 Schedule TO-I offers to exchange up to 225,361,295 newly issued MiniMed common shares.
Medtronic's October 7, 2026 Rule 425 sets the final exchange ratio at 4.5939 MiniMed shares per accepted Medtronic share because the calculated ratio was above that upper limit.

The October 14, 2026 Rule 425 says the offer expired at midnight at the end of October 9, 2026. Medtronic will exchange 252,813,348 MiniMed shares for 55,032,401 Medtronic shares and will not retain any MiniMed shares. Of 297,521,390 Medtronic shares tendered, 757,890 were odd lots accepted in full and the rest take a final proration factor of 18.289133 percent.

supporting_filings.note: Final exchange ratio 4.5939, the upper limit.
